gadgets.name: Bomb
gadgets.description: Throw it in a fight for 2 damage. The blast reveals part of the board.

gadgets.name: Patch kit
gadgets.description: Use in a fight to block the next hit.

gadgets.name: Sponge
gadgets.description: Use in a fight to wipe all the ink off the board.

fog.name: Fog
fog.tip: Some clues are hidden. Work those lines out from the ones crossing them; finishing a line reveals its clue.

scramble.name: Scrambled clues
scramble.tip: The <gear> clues have the right numbers in the wrong order. Finishing the line puts them back.

armor.name: Armor
armor.tip: Only <target> lines hurt it, for triple damage. Every 5 other lines you finish, the armor hits back. Solve the <target> lines to break it.

fakes.name: Forged clues
fakes.tip: Some <mask> clues are fakes, but not all. Don't trust them: solve those lines from the ones crossing them. Honest ones light up; a fake stays dark. Then <search> Call out the fake.

charge.name: Charge
charge.tip: After a warm-up, each line you finish charges the <bolt> meter, and when it's full you get zapped. Finish the yellow live line first to ground it. Take as long as you like: only finished lines count.

ink.name: Ink
ink.tip: Ink hides your marks, but you can still play there. Finishing a line through it washes it off.

swap.name: Swaps
swap.tip: Two lines get wiped clean and boxed with <lips>. Fill them in again.

rotate.name: Turns
rotate.tip: Every few lines you finish, the <turn> meter fills and the whole board turns a quarter clockwise. Your marks, clues and everything on them turn too: rows become columns. Only finished lines count.

chapters.title: Odd Jobs
chapters.blurb: Rook and Dee hang out a sign: no job too strange.

chapters.title: After Hours
chapters.blurb: Word gets around. Mostly to people with haunted things.

chapters.title: Deep Water
chapters.blurb: The jobs get wetter. Rook still hasn't learned to swim.

chapters.title: Green Thumbs
chapters.blurb: Everything in here wants to eat you. Politely, at first.

chapters.title: Step Right Up
chapters.blurb: The show must go on. Nobody can remember why.

chapters.title: Cold Snap
chapters.blurb: The air gets thin. The bill does not.

chapters.title: End of the Line
chapters.blurb: Forty years late, and still apologizing.

chapters.title: Below Stairs
chapters.blurb: Tours daily. Gift shop. Do not go past the gift shop.

chapters.title: Peer Review
chapters.blurb: The results are in. Nobody will say whose they are.

runs.name: Closing Time
runs.blurb: A private viewing at the museum, by invitation only. Bring the keys.

runs.name: The Deep End
runs.blurb: The aquarium's tanks are acting up. Bring a towel.

runs.name: The Deep End: Overtime
runs.blurb: Same aquarium, after feeding time. Hits on, no patch kit, and nobody fed them enough.

runs.name: First Job
runs.blurb: Mrs. Pell's generator needs a part by sundown. Something lives in it.

runs.name: First Job: Overtime
runs.blurb: Same workshop, later shift. Hits on, no patch kit, and the locals have been practicing.

runs.name: The Glasshouse
runs.blurb: The botanical garden's plants have stopped taking direction. One of them bit a school group.

runs.name: The Glasshouse: Overtime
runs.blurb: Same greenhouse, warmer night. Hits on, no patch kit, and everything has grown.

runs.name: The Midway
runs.blurb: A carnival that runs all night with nobody aboard. The flyer says SEND HELP.

runs.name: The Midway: Overtime
runs.blurb: Same carnival, last show of the night. Hits on, no patch kit, and the acts have new tricks.

runs.name: The Night Mail
runs.blurb: A closed railway with a very late train. Mind the gap. Mind the signals.

runs.name: The Night Mail: Overtime
runs.blurb: Same line, the last train after the last train. Hits on, no bomb, and the timetable has changed.

runs.name: The Night Shift
runs.blurb: The museum's exhibits come alive after closing. Double rates.

runs.name: The Night Shift: Overtime
runs.blurb: Same museum, longer night. Hits on, no bomb, and everything has learned new tricks.

runs.name: Summit Station
runs.blurb: A mountaintop observatory that's stopped answering its radio. Bring a coat.

runs.name: Summit Station: Overtime
runs.blurb: Same mountain, worse weather. Hits on, no bomb, and the snow has been busy.

runs.name: The Annex
runs.blurb: A research building that isn't on any plan but still gets a power bill.

runs.name: The Annex: Overtime
runs.blurb: Same lab, the all-nighter. Hits on, no patch kit, and every experiment has been repeated.

runs.name: The Undercroft
runs.blurb: A castle tour that used to go down one flight of stairs. Today it goes down nine.

runs.name: The Undercroft: Overtime
runs.blurb: Same cellars, one flight deeper. Hits on, no patch kit, and the dark has been rearranging things.

runs.name: The Weathervane
runs.blurb: Something on the observatory roof is still spinning after the storm. One fight, and the board won't sit still.

encounters.name: Anglerfish
encounters.blurb: The deep-sea tank. Pitch black, except for one friendly little light.

phases.name: Hungry Anglerfish
phases.taunt: Come closer. Look at the pretty light.

encounters.name: Armored Beetle
encounters.blurb: A museum beetle the size of a hatchback. Look for the cracks.

encounters.name: Break room
encounters.blurb: The guards' coffee. Strong enough to wake an exhibit.

encounters.name: Cellar Ooze
encounters.blurb: It ate the tour map. It kept the skull. It is very nearly cube-shaped.

encounters.name: Clockwork Owl
encounters.blurb: Its gears whir. Your clues start spinning.

encounters.name: Coal Heap
encounters.blurb: The stationmaster calls it Gerald. Aim for the cracks, and mind your clean work.

phases.name: Stoked Gerald
phases.taunt: Gerald would like a word. The word is coal.

encounters.name: Cocoa break
encounters.blurb: Dr. Lund insists. Drink it before it freezes.

encounters.name: The Curator
encounters.blurb: The curator's office. It's ticking.

phases.taunt: Allow me to re-label that for you.

phases.name: Unfolded Curator
phases.taunt: Flat was never my best side.

encounters.name: Cuttlefish
encounters.blurb: It changes color when it's upset. It's very upset.

encounters.name: Dig site
encounters.blurb: Something mechanical is buried out here. Dig it up; nothing here bites.

encounters.name: Dusty Exhibit
encounters.blurb: A display case nobody has dusted since 1952. Something useful is under there.

encounters.name: Electric Eel
encounters.blurb: The touch tank hums. Don't touch the tank.

encounters.name: Faculty lounge
encounters.blurb: The kettle works. The noodles have a best-before date. Don't read it.

encounters.name: Failed Clone
encounters.blurb: Attempt 41 copied everything except the instructions. It would like to help.

phases.taunt: It copies your work. Into the wrong place.

encounters.name: Falling Star
encounters.blurb: The charts say it's coming. Then they say it isn't. One of them is lying.

phases.name: Blazing Star
phases.taunt: Make a wish. Make it quick.

encounters.name: Fog bat
encounters.blurb: A bat that breathes fog over your clues. Gross, and also a problem.

encounters.name: The Forger
encounters.blurb: The gallery's paintings look... slightly off.

phases.name: Master Forger
phases.taunt: Every clue's a masterpiece. Some are even real.

encounters.name: Funhouse Mirror
encounters.blurb: It makes you look taller. It also makes your clues look wrong.

phases.taunt: Is that really how you left it?

encounters.name: Garden bench
encounters.blurb: A bench, a watering can, and the only plants in here that behave.

encounters.name: Gift Shop
encounters.blurb: Plush sharks, snow globes, and one suspiciously absorbent souvenir.

encounters.name: Goblin
encounters.blurb: A goblin is guarding the workshop's back door. It wants your lunch.

encounters.name: The Great Bruno
encounters.blurb: He can lift a horse. Nobody asked the horse. Aim for the cracks in the iron.

encounters.name: Generator Gremlin
encounters.blurb: The generator isn't broken. Something lives in it, and it likes the dark.

encounters.name: Guard room
encounters.blurb: Whoever was on watch left in a hurry. They also left the mead.

encounters.name: Ice Mammoth
encounters.blurb: It thawed out and it's sitting on the generator. Find the gaps in the ice.

encounters.name: Ironbark
encounters.blurb: An old stump with a bad attitude. Count the rings, then hit it there.

phases.name: Riled Ironbark
phases.taunt: A hundred years of growth, and you bring a pencil?

encounters.name: Lifeguard chair
encounters.blurb: Sit down. Dry off. Don't look at the big tank.

encounters.name: Lost Property
encounters.blurb: Forty years of forgotten umbrellas, and one suitcase that smells of soap.

encounters.name: Madame Vesper
encounters.blurb: She sees all, she knows all, and at least some of it is true.

phases.name: Vesper Unveiled
phases.taunt: I foresaw that you would say that.

encounters.name: Mimic
encounters.blurb: A treasure chest in the gift shop. It's breathing.

encounters.name: Mother Bramble
encounters.blurb: The center dome. Nobody has seen the door since Thursday.

phases.name: Thorned Bramble
phases.taunt: Every spring you prune me. Every spring I remember.

encounters.name: Museum Rex
encounters.blurb: The main hall's centerpiece. It has not moved in ninety years. It's moving.

phases.taunt: A rib flies off and rearranges your work.

encounters.name: Old Tess
encounters.blurb: The big tank in the middle. Something in there is watching the door.

phases.name: Eight-Armed Tess
phases.taunt: I have eight arms and you have two.

encounters.name: The Old Wyrm
encounters.blurb: The ninth flight down. The hoard is breathing. Aim between the scales, and don't trust all the gold.

phases.taunt: Its coils shift across the hoard.
A snort of black smoke rolls over everything.

encounters.name: Professor Ostrander
encounters.blurb: Top floor. Every wall is charts, and every chart has been corrected.

phases.name: Professor Emerita
phases.taunt: Your figures do not add up.
I think you will find these belong the other way round.

encounters.name: Anglerfish
encounters.blurb: The little light is brighter now. The rest of the tank is darker.

phases.name: Hungry Anglerfish
phases.taunt: Come closer. Look at the pretty light.
The pretty light starts to hum.

encounters.name: Armored Beetle
encounters.blurb: It's still mostly large. It has also found the carpet.

phases.taunt: It has been rubbing its legs on the carpet.
It is leaking something. Probably fine.

encounters.name: Cellar Ooze
encounters.blurb: It ate the other tour map. It is now very nearly a larger cube.

phases.taunt: It has swallowed a lantern. The lantern is still on.

encounters.name: Clockwork Owl
encounters.blurb: Someone wound it tighter. It has started keeping its own time.

encounters.name: Coal Heap
encounters.blurb: Gerald has been stoked. Gerald is warm. Gerald is sparking slightly.

phases.name: Stoked Gerald
phases.taunt: Gerald would like a word. The word is coal.

encounters.name: Cuttlefish
encounters.blurb: It's still upset. It has also worked out how to hide.

phases.taunt: Pfft! Now where did it go?

encounters.name: Electric Eel
encounters.blurb: Someone replaced the tank heater with a car battery. The eel approves.

encounters.name: Failed Clone
encounters.blurb: Attempt 43 copied the instructions too. It did not read them.

phases.taunt: It copies your work. Into the wrong place.
It copies the spill on the floor. Onto your work.

encounters.name: Falling Star
encounters.blurb: It came down after all. The charts still disagree about where.

phases.name: Blazing Star
phases.taunt: Make a wish. Make it quick.

encounters.name: Fog bat
encounters.blurb: The bat has a cold. The fog is thicker, and it sneezes.

encounters.name: The Forger
encounters.blurb: The Forger has had time to practice, and the paint is still wet.

phases.name: Master Forger
phases.taunt: Every clue's a masterpiece. Some are even real.

encounters.name: Funhouse Mirror
encounters.blurb: Someone polished it. Now it makes your clues look wrong from further away.

phases.taunt: Is that really how you left it?

encounters.name: Goblin
encounters.blurb: The goblin is back for your lunch. It has learned to read your clues upside down.

phases.taunt: It throws your lunch at the board.

encounters.name: The Great Bruno
encounters.blurb: He has added a second horse. Still nobody asked the horses.

phases.taunt: BRUNO JUGGLES. YOUR LINES ARE THE BALLS.

encounters.name: Generator Gremlin
encounters.blurb: The generator's been fixed. The thing living in it hasn't.

phases.taunt: It plugs itself into the mains.

encounters.name: Ice Mammoth
encounters.blurb: Back on the generator, and it brought the rest of the glacier.

encounters.name: Ironbark
encounters.blurb: Another ring since you were here. It counted every one of them.

phases.name: Riled Ironbark
phases.taunt: A hundred years of growth, and you bring a pencil?

encounters.name: Madame Vesper
encounters.blurb: She foresaw your return. She has prepared more of the truth than usual.

phases.taunt: I see a spark in your future.

phases.name: Vesper Unveiled
phases.taunt: I foresaw that you would say that.

encounters.name: Mimic
encounters.blurb: The chest learned a new trick while you were gone. It still bites.

encounters.name: Mother Bramble
encounters.blurb: The center dome again. She's been pruned, and she's been planning.

phases.name: Thorned Bramble
phases.taunt: Every spring you prune me. Every spring I remember.
The roots find the sprinkler wiring.

encounters.name: Museum Rex
encounters.blurb: Back on its feet, and missing fewer pieces than you'd hope.

phases.taunt: A rib flies off and rearranges your work.
Somebody left the fuse box in its ribcage.

encounters.name: Old Tess
encounters.blurb: Somebody cleaned her tank. She has not forgiven anyone.

phases.name: Eight-Armed Tess
phases.taunt: I have eight arms and you have two.

encounters.name: The Old Wyrm
encounters.blurb: The ninth flight down, again. The hoard is bigger. So is the Wyrm.

phases.taunt: Its coils shift across the hoard.
A snort of black smoke rolls over everything.
It rolls over in its sleep. The hoard rolls with it.

encounters.name: Professor Ostrander
encounters.blurb: Top floor, after hours. The charts have been corrected again, in pen.

phases.name: Professor Emerita
phases.taunt: Your figures do not add up.
I think you will find these belong the other way round.
Office hours are over. The lights are on a timer.

encounters.name: The Rat King
encounters.blurb: He has a sceptre now. He has also forged the receipt for that.

phases.taunt: The court spills the royal ink.
The court rearranges itself around you.
A rat chews through a cable. It looks pleased.

encounters.name: Reviewer Two
encounters.blurb: Reviewer Two has read your revisions. Reviewer Two has more comments.

phases.taunt: Red pen bleeds through the page.
Please move section three to section five.

phases.name: Reviewer Two, Revised
phases.taunt: A few minor changes. Start again.

encounters.name: The Ringmaster
encounters.blurb: The big top, for the encore. Two spotlights now, and the moustache has been waxed.

phases.name: Grand Ringmaster
phases.taunt: Keep your eye on the numbers!
A little confetti for the front row!

encounters.name: Rusted Sentry
encounters.blurb: It has oiled its neck. It turns its head a lot more now.

phases.taunt: Its halberd clips your work and sends two lines flying.
Rust flakes off in a cloud.

encounters.name: Signal Box
encounters.blurb: Still showing red. It has found some new colors since you left.

phases.name: Crossed Signals
phases.taunt: The lamp goes from red to something else.
The points clunk over. Sparks fly.

encounters.name: Snapjaw
encounters.blurb: Someone has been feeding it. It has stopped counting and started guessing.

encounters.name: Spark Hound
encounters.blurb: Still not to be petted. The signs have been updated, and so has the dog.

phases.taunt: Its fur stands on end. Then so does yours.
It shakes. Something wet goes everywhere.

encounters.name: Spore Puff
encounters.blurb: It has been to seed. The seeds have been to seed.

encounters.name: The 11:59
encounters.blurb: Platform one again. It made up the forty years, and now it is early.

phases.taunt: Smoke pours out of the funnel.
The carriages uncouple and change places.

phases.name: Express, Not Stopping
phases.taunt: Stand clear of the platform edge.

encounters.name: Ticket Inspector
encounters.blurb: Still checking the same carriage. He has started making up the timetable too.

encounters.name: Whiteout
encounters.blurb: Someone rebuilt the snowman. It looks a lot like the last person who tried.

encounters.name: The Yeti
encounters.blurb: The ridge again. There are more footprints this time, and they are bigger.

encounters.name: Popcorn stand
encounters.blurb: Nobody is minding it. Nobody is charging for it. Eat fast.

encounters.name: Potting Shed
encounters.blurb: Bags of soil, a broken rake, and a gourd that is suspiciously absorbent.

encounters.name: Prop Wagon
encounters.blurb: Costumes, a unicycle, and something under a tarp labeled DO NOT LIGHT.

encounters.name: The Rat King
encounters.blurb: He got the crown from the gift shop. He's forged the receipt.

phases.taunt: The court rearranges itself around you.

encounters.name: Reviewer Two
encounters.blurb: Nobody knows who Reviewer Two is. Everybody has met Reviewer Two. Find the weak arguments.

phases.name: Reviewer Two, Revised
phases.taunt: A few minor changes. Start again.

encounters.name: The Ringmaster
encounters.blurb: The big top. One spotlight, one top hat, and a very long moustache.

phases.name: Grand Ringmaster
phases.taunt: Keep your eye on the numbers!

encounters.name: Rusted Sentry
encounters.blurb: Not one of the castle's. The castle's ones don't turn their heads.

phases.taunt: Its halberd clips your work and sends two lines flying.

encounters.name: Signal Box
encounters.blurb: It's been showing red since before the line closed. It has opinions now.

phases.name: Crossed Signals
phases.taunt: The lamp goes from red to something else.

encounters.name: Snapjaw
encounters.blurb: A flytrap the size of a wheelbarrow. It has started counting.

encounters.name: Spark Hound
encounters.blurb: Don't pet the dog. It's on the sign, and on the other sign.

phases.taunt: Its fur stands on end. Then so does yours.

encounters.name: Spore Puff
encounters.blurb: Do not breathe in. Do not breathe out. Honestly, just leave.

encounters.name: Station buffet
encounters.blurb: The urn is still hot. Nobody's sure who has been filling it. Drink up.

encounters.name: Supply Cache
encounters.blurb: Tinned soup, spare socks, and the warmest thing on this mountain.

encounters.name: Supply Closet
encounters.blurb: Labeled SPILLS ONLY. Considering the state of this building, that covers it.

encounters.name: Tea break
encounters.blurb: Mrs. Pell left a thermos on the steps. It's still warm.

encounters.name: The 11:59
encounters.blurb: Platform one. Forty years late, and picking up speed.

phases.taunt: The carriages uncouple and change places.

phases.name: Express, Not Stopping
phases.taunt: Stand clear of the platform edge.

encounters.name: Ticket Inspector
encounters.blurb: He has been checking the same empty carriage since 1986. Some of his paperwork is made up.

encounters.name: Tin Soldier
encounters.blurb: Exhibit 12: Toy Soldier, c. 1890. Life-size as of this evening.

encounters.name: Weathervane
encounters.blurb: It points wherever the wind says. Today the wind says you.

encounters.name: Whiteout
encounters.blurb: Whoever built this snowman isn't up here anymore.

encounters.name: Wine Cellar
encounters.blurb: Most of these barrels are wine. Check the label on this one twice.

encounters.name: The Yeti
encounters.blurb: The ridge above the station. There are footprints going up. None come back.

lines.text: Chapter 2: After Hours. The office, a week after the gremlin.
Mrs. Pell told her book club. Her book club told everyone.
Is that a good thing?
We have eleven voicemails. Nine are about things that move at night.
Then we work nights. Get the flashlight. And the other flashlight.
Chapter 8: Below Stairs. The office. A leaflet on the desk has a cartoon knight on it.
Castle Ambry. Daily tours, a gift shop, jousting on Sundays.
What's the problem?
The tour used to go down one flight of stairs. Yesterday it went down nine. They have lost a school trip's packed lunches and a man called Dennis.
Who is Dennis?
He plays Sir Dennis, in the jousting. He went down on Tuesday to look for the lunches.
I hope somebody told him the lunches are not worth it.
The center dome. Thorns across the door, roses across the ceiling, and one bloom the size of a van.
That is Mother Bramble. She won a ribbon once.
Rook, look at the stem. That's a brass key.
Someone wound up a rose? Can we unwind it?
Try.
The museum, after closing. The exhibits stand very still, and every label has been rewritten in a neat hand.
He's re-labeled the whole collection.
The fire exit says 'Exhibit 40: Hope'.
Rook. Something is marching.
Curator back in his case. For real this time. I watched Rook lock it.
And he paid the invoice. Clockwork people are very punctual.
He didn't make these keys, you know. The maker's mark isn't his.
That sounds like next week's problem.
He's re-labeled us. I'm 'Exhibit 41: Unpaid'.
Chapter 6: Cold Snap. The van, pointed uphill, with chains on its tires.
The Summit Station observatory hasn't answered its radio in a week.
Maybe they are busy.
Their last two messages were 'the snowman moved' and 'that's not a snowman'.
Right. It's a mountain, so I packed a coat.
I'm packing towels.
The curator's office. Every clock in the room is ticking in time with the jar.
Splendid work. Truly. You have returned all my keys.
He's been winding things up all over the county. Curator, why?
Every collection needs a curator. And this collection was missing its two finest pieces.
You still owe us for the night shift.
Then do collect. Lights, please!
The aquarium, after closing. Every tank glows blue. One of them is sparking.
Thank goodness. I'm Bo, night keeper. The animals have been... organizing.
Organizing how?
The eel shorted the lights. The cuttlefish inked the gift shop. And Old Tess hasn't blinked in three days.
Eels zap unless you finish the live line. Ink hides your marks until you finish a line through it. Noted.
And Old Tess is...?
In charge.
She's sulking under her rock. The eel's asleep. I could cry.
Tanks clean, lights on, nobody inked. Mostly nobody inked.
I'm putting 'octopus diplomacy' on the business cards.
I can't feel my arms. Old Tess can feel all eight of hers.
Chapter 3: Deep Water. A van, a map, and a smell of low tide.
You told the aquarium we're 'water-certified'.
We are. I've been near water. I've been in water. Once.
I'm packing towels.
Chapter 7: End of the Line. The office. A train timetable has come under the door, forty years out of date.
Halt Junction. That line closed before either of us was born.
Then why is the stationmaster phoning us about delays?
Because the 11:59 still comes through. Every night. Nobody's driving it.
Is it on time, at least?
Forty years late. They'd like it to stop apologizing over the loudspeakers.
I'll get the van.
Monday at the workshop. Something is beeping. Nobody knows what.
Great news, everybody! I got us a job. A real one. With money.
Rook, the last "real job" was a raccoon's birthday party.
And it paid in exposure! Anyway. Mrs. Pell's generator died, and she needs a new part by sundown.
Easy. We find the part, bolt it in, go home legends.
Small catch: there's a goblin at her back door.
That's a medium catch.
Also the part's buried at the old dig site. Also her cellar has a bat.
No bat is normal. This one breathes fog.
Right into your clues. Very rude.
You solve the pictures, boss. I'll yell encouragement from a safe distance.
And I'll handle the invoice!
You grab your toolbox. Something is still beeping.
Generator's humming, the gremlin's evicted, and Rook invoiced a bat. Nice work, boss.
Okay, we didn't get paid. But we're alive, which is basically a tip.
The east gallery. Every painting is still wet.
Ah, visitors! Admire my collection. Every clue on that canvas is genuine. Mostly.
See the <mask> clues? Five of them. Three are fakes. The other two are telling the truth.
So we don't trust any <mask> clue. We solve those rows from the columns. If a row lights up, it was honest.
And if it's filled right but stays dark, it's a forgery. Then we tap <search> Call out and point at it. Guess wrong and it hurts us.
The Glasshouse, after dark. Every pane is fogged. Something in there is breathing.
You're the odd-jobs people? Good. Mind the flytrap. It's been learning.
Learning what?
Timing. It snaps at anything that dawdles, and it'll rip up your work out of spite.
That's two tricks at once. The museum's exhibits only had one each.
Everything in here has two tricks now. And the old rose in the center dome has more than that.
Two tricks, two rates. Lead the way.
She's back to being a rose. A bad-tempered rose, but those I can manage.
And one more brass key, same maker as the museum's. Into the jar it goes.
I'm putting 'plant whisperer' on the business cards. Right under 'octopus diplomacy'.
I've been pruned. I'd like that noted on the invoice.
Chapter 4: Green Thumbs. The office. A towel is still drying on the radiator.
The botanical garden called. Their head gardener says the plants have stopped taking direction.
Plants don't take direction. That's what makes them plants.
One of them bit a school group.
Book it. Where did I put my lucky key?
It is evidence. It lives in the jar. It has a label.
Part in hand, you reach Mrs. Pell's generator. It rattles. Then it giggles.
Generators shouldn't giggle.
Mrs. Pell? Quick question. Did you know you have a gremlin?
This is MY generator. I've lived here rent-free since 1987.
And I like it DARK. Good luck reading your little numbers.
Boss, I made you something. The Wrench of Science. Picture it, then hit him with it.
Wrench? WRENCH?!
The Midway at midnight. Every bulb is lit and the music is a little too slow.
Bigsby. I own this place. Owned. The Ringmaster's been running it since Tuesday.
Is the Ringmaster a problem?
We never hired a ringmaster.
